about: One table of the English a run says (WORKFLOW1c5, D157, .claude/knowledge/twins.md). The driver's WorkflowRunWords.cs says it in a terminal, the page's workflow/runSaid.ts and the workflow.run.* catalogue say it on the page; WorkflowRunSaidTwinTests.cs and workflow/runSaid.test.ts each read every row. A row is a step's kind, state (working where omitted), detail and the facts its words use; said is the sentence, null where the state's word says it all. A row with a node is a graph run's node (FABRIC-CUTOVER1e): its own kind, its detail its record's state, on the subject it observes; graph is what a graph run says above its nodes, line for line. A name from a record is in backticks. chatChecks is what a chat run says of its checks until they are enforced on its tree (CHATFLOW1c, the chat-flow design §4.4). A none row is a code a read that names no run answers (CHATFLOW1a, the chat-flow design §10): its code, the record's id or the workflow's id its words name, and its sentence, which the terminal says and the page's workflow.run.noRun.* says in en. The terminal's own words (the head line, the marks, this session, the presses under a step) and the step titles, which the page words by Current's own step, stay out.
